title: Associated Functions
goal: Functions inside an impl block without self create constructors or utility functions.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Methods and Traits

sections.text: In C++ or Java, static methods belong to the type itself.

sections.caption: Point groups two coordinates together.

sections.text: Functions in an `impl` block without a `self` parameter are associated functions.

sections.caption: Self inside impl is an alias for Point.

sections.text: Call associated functions with double colons like `Point::new(1, 2)`. The `Self` keyword refers to the type inside the `impl` block.

sections.caption: Double colons access items on the type.

sections.text: Associated functions often serve as constructors. Rust has no automatic initializers or constructor keywords.

explanation: Functions inside an impl block without self create constructors or utility functions.
